baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative beautifying, their deeds, resulting diversion, the way, and the final active description of insight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Beautifying recodes an already apprehensible course at the level of desire. Their intentional conduct becomes attractive enough to divert practice without erasing inner recognition.

activation_trace.role: Making beauty appear supplies the evaluative recoding that attracts conduct.
Rebellious opposition supplies the agency that contests right orientation.
Intentional doing makes their own chosen acts the material being recoded.
Turning aside supplies the practical displacement produced by the recoding.
A traversable means or course supplies the destination from which conduct is diverted.
Inner sight preserves genuine recognition inside the mechanism of misorientation.

changed_reading.before: A hostile agent blocked people who happened to possess sight.
changed_reading.after: The blockage is practical akrasia: rebellious beautification redirects desire through chosen conduct while recognition remains available.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Clarity is now given to the addressees from the former inhabitants' dwellings, while the inhabitants themselves are described through sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled places outlast their occupants and become evidence. The construction transfers the burden of seeing from formerly perceptive actors to present observers who can read what remains.

activation_trace.role: Becoming manifest turns the dwelling-sites into presently available evidence.
Dwelling and settlement provide the durable material location from which evidence is read.
Cessation of motion lets the inhabited place resonate as a stilled residue.
Seeing with the eye makes the surviving places inspectable by a later audience.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings merely locate two past peoples.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings function as forensic witnesses: former perceivers have vanished, but their settled traces now address the sight of others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence makes beautification of their deeds immediately issue in their being barred.
baseline_models.mechanism: The resulting conjunction makes the beautified deeds, rather than a separate obstacle, the likely medium of obstruction. Satan supplies the framing, while the people supply and repeat the operative conduct.

activation_trace.role: The rebellious being supplies hostile evaluative agency.
Presented beauty is the transformation that makes the obstructive medium desirable.
Intentional deeds provide the endogenous mechanism through which diversion is enacted.
Diversion names the functional outcome of continuing the attractive conduct.

changed_reading.before: Beautification and road-blocking are two successive but independent acts.
changed_reading.after: Beautification converts their own work into the roadblock, producing a feedback loop shared between external suggestion and human enactment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrast between supposition and assaying revises insight from a possession into a capacity whose truth is disclosed only when intentional conduct is tested.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies the capacity whose practical reliability is at issue.
Intentional action supplies the field in which claimed insight becomes testable.
Mental supposition supplies an unverified self-assessment that may not survive events.
Assaying by trial supplies the process that separates apparent quality from proven quality.
Fulfillment in action supplies the criterion by which an inward claim becomes true in practice.

structural_cues: The pericope opens with profession, testing, and differentiation before presenting the focus's perceptive but diverted peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, assay, and enacted confirmation; I infer that the focus's sight is evaluated by whether it survives action, while the live alternative is that the opening test concerns only the professing audience.

changed_reading.before: Their insight is a stable possession mysteriously contradicted by conduct.
changed_reading.after: Their insight is real capacity but failed assay: action exposes that it never became governing fidelity.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rival route is socially marketed with a false promise that its moral cost can be carried by recruiters. The promise beautifies following by externalizing liability, but the next sequence converts that sales pitch into added burden.

activation_trace.role: Attractive presentation supplies the persuasive surface of the rival offer.
The traversable course anchors the context's competing route back in the focus.
Following after supplies the recruitment motion solicited by human speakers.
An explicitly offered route supplies the social alternative to the focus's way.
Bearing moral responsibility supplies the promised transfer of the follower's cost.
Falsehood invalidates the promised insurance while explaining its seductive force.
Repeated heaviness reverses the promise into accumulated load for those who recruit.

structural_cues: The imperative to follow is immediately coupled to a liability promise, negated as false, and followed by a multiplication of burdens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recruitment, a rival route, false burden-transfer, and accumulated loads; I infer that human persuasion can mediate satanic beautification, while inward temptation without social mediation remains live.

changed_reading.before: Satanic diversion is primarily a private distortion of perception.
changed_reading.after: Diversion can be socially distributed as an attractive route whose promoters falsely advertise that someone else will absorb its consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through the land and directed inspection turn material traces into an inference from beginning to return. The focus's way consequently becomes an epistemic itinerary, and its dwellings become evidence encountered along that itinerary.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling-sites supply the material stations inspected along the route.
The traversed way anchors movement and inference in one construction.
Inner sight supplies the faculty expected to convert observation into orientation.
Seeing by eye or insight initiates the context's explicit inferential question.
Beginning paired with return supplies the conceptual arc observation is meant to recover.
Actual return after beginning supplies the second endpoint of the inference.
Travel through the earth makes knowing an embodied movement rather than static possession.
Directed examination supplies the deliberate reading of what travel exposes.

structural_cues: A question about seeing is followed by paired imperatives to travel and inspect, before the focus says that something is clear from dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, inspection, beginning, return, and visible dwellings; I infer that these form one epistemic route, while the live alternative is that 29:19-20 serves only as a resurrection proof.

changed_reading.before: The way is a known proposition from which people are diverted.
changed_reading.after: The way is also a method of knowing: move, inspect traces, and carry sight through to an inference about origins and returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shared objects and practices are stabilized by affection between participants. Their later reversal into mutual repudiation and expulsion reveals that adornment operated as social attachment, not merely as visual prettification.

activation_trace.role: Presented beauty supplies the affective appeal attached to collective practice.
Intentional deeds provide the repeated practice through which attachment is maintained.
The worshipped object supplies a shared material center for the relation.
Loving attachment supplies the social glue that makes the practice desirable.
A tie between parties supplies the relational structure sustained by the shared object.
Disavowal supplies the future reversal that exposes the bond's instability.
Punitive distancing converts former closeness into mutual expulsion.

structural_cues: Worldly affection between participants is followed by a temporal reversal into mutual disavowal and cursing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared objects, affection, connection, and later repudiation; I infer that affection is a channel of the focus's adornment, while it may alternatively be only a consequence of already adopted worship.

changed_reading.before: Adornment makes isolated individuals like their deeds.
changed_reading.after: Adornment builds affective infrastructure: people love one another through shared deeds, and that social warmth helps keep the rival course in place.

context_deltas.mechanism: A condemned group does not merely leave the way; its public practice cuts the way. Beautified wrongdoing therefore becomes recursive: those diverted from a course enact obstruction against other travelers.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and prevention anchor the recursive blocking mechanism in the focus.
The traversed way supplies what is first lost and then obstructed for others.
Intentional conduct supplies the human enactment of the obstruction.
Road interception supplies an enacted form of barring travelers from a route.
The explicit road makes the focus's abstract diversion materially and socially concrete.
The gathered council supplies the public institution in which obstructive conduct is normalized.
Condemned action supplies the public moral quality of that institutionalized practice.

structural_cues: The context coordinates approaching, cutting the road, and performing condemned action in the assembly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal road-cutting and public wrongdoing; I infer a recurring mechanism in which diverted people become diverters, while the live alternative is a concrete road crime confined to that narrated group.

changed_reading.before: The peoples are passive objects of a roadblock.
changed_reading.after: Their adorned works can themselves reproduce the roadblock, converting misdirected travelers into agents who close passage for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: A violent event arrests bodies and habitation into stillness; what is left then functions as a manifest sign for restrained understanding. The focus's dwelling root activates both residence and cessation of motion.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling supplies the inhabited material setting preserved after its social life ends.
Cessation after movement supplies the arrested stillness now legible in that setting.
Manifest clarity supplies the conversion of arrested habitat into evidence.
Leaving an effect to remain supplies deliberate persistence of the material trace.
A visible sign supplies the evidentiary function assigned to what remains.
Explicit clarity confirms that the retained trace is meant to disclose.
Understanding as restraint supplies the response expected from observers of the sign.
Violent shaking supplies the event that interrupts ordinary settled motion.
Clinging low and remaining fixed supplies the terminal stillness left in the dwelling.

structural_cues: A clear sign is said to have been left, another people pass from shaking to fixed crouching in their home, and the focus then points to dwellings as clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retained signs, violent motion, terminal immobility, and dwellings; I infer a montage in which destruction makes habitation legible, while the live alternative keeps each community's trace narratively separate.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are passive remnants that happen to verify a report.
changed_reading.after: They are arrested event-records: inhabited motion has been stilled and left visible so a later observer's reason can complete the lesson.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear evidence encounters self-magnifying refusal, which cannot outrun accountability and is taken for its own offense. This keeps satanic framing causally live while denying that it removes human authorship or liability.

activation_trace.role: Rebellious agency supplies the external pressure without exhausting the causal account.
Attractive presentation supplies influence rather than coercive compulsion.
Intentional deeds preserve the people's authored contribution to the outcome.
Manifest proofs remove lack of evidence as the sufficient explanation.
Self-exaltation supplies a voluntary posture of refusal toward the proofs.
Failure to escape pursuit supplies the collapse of imagined exemption.
Taking to account supplies the juridical consequence attached to authored conduct.
Culpable offense supplies the individualized ground of accountability.
The very self locates the injury and agency internally rather than solely in the tempter.

structural_cues: Immediately after the focus, proofs lead to arrogance and failed escape; the catalogue then assigns each case its own offense and contrasts divine injustice with self-wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evidence, arrogant refusal, offense-based seizure, and self-directed wrong; I infer that this adjudicates the focus's agency grammar, while the alternative is that 29:39-40 merely adds judgment without explaining the earlier psychology.

changed_reading.before: Naming Satan as subject risks making the people chiefly passive victims of deception.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents layered agency: Satan frames, people author and persist in the deeds, and accountability attaches to the selves that enact the diversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus and 29:45 present rival directional restraints: one bars from the way, while established prayer restrains from gross and condemned conduct. Guidance thus involves forming a stronger embodied inhibition rather than merely removing every restraint.

activation_trace.role: Turning aside supplies the first directional restraint.
Repeated intentional conduct supplies the habit-bearing substrate of that restraint.
Prescribed embodied worship supplies the counter-practice that can redirect conduct.
Restraint from an act supplies the inverse directional force to the focus's diversion.
Gross ugliness supplies one conduct-field from which the counter-practice turns its participant.
Condemned action supplies the second field blocked by ritual formation.
Bringing a reality to mind supplies counter-salience against deceptive beautification.
Making and doing reconnect the ritual claim to the actual conduct known and evaluated.

structural_cues: The focus's blocking-from construction is answered by 29:45's restraining-from construction, with deeds or making present at both ends.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed restraint constructions, embodied worship, remembrance, and doing; I infer a counter-habit mechanism, while the live alternative treats prayer's restraint as a normative result without specifying psychological retraining.

changed_reading.before: Freedom from satanic blockage would mean simply recovering an unobstructed route.
changed_reading.after: Right orientation requires a counter-formation: ritual and remembrance install an inhibition against the deeds that otherwise become attractive roadblocks.

context_deltas.mechanism: Correct creator-language and crisis exclusivity coexist with directional turning and immediate post-rescue association. The focus's perceptiveness can therefore be genuine yet episodic, compartmentalized, and unable to govern settled ordinary life.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication permits insight to be a real state without guaranteeing permanence.
Inner sight supplies the genuine but potentially compartmentalized recognition.
Diversion explains why episodic recognition does not stabilize direction.
Uttered speech supplies an explicit correct answer at the propositional level.
Origination supplies the reality correctly attributed in that answer.
Being turned from proper direction supplies the gap between correct speech and lived orientation.
Understanding as restraint marks what the majority fail to derive from their correct acknowledgment.
Exclusive separation from partners supplies genuine crisis-time concentration.
Deliverance by separation supplies the transition out of the crisis state.
Restored association supplies the immediate collapse of crisis-time exclusivity.

structural_cues: A correct answer is followed by a question about directional turning; later, crisis exclusivity is followed immediately by rescue and renewed association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies correct confession, directional inversion, crisis exclusivity, rescue, and relapse; I infer that the focus's sight may be state-dependent, while an ironic or merely self-ascribed reading of perceptiveness remains live.

changed_reading.before: The final description must be either fully sincere insight or pure sarcasm.
changed_reading.after: A third reading becomes live: genuine episodes of lucidity coexist with durable misorientation because recognition does not persist across conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah reverses the focus's causal geometry: rebellious agency bars people from one named way, whereas exertion is answered by guidance into multiple divine ways. Sight alone does not generate passage; committed movement opens it.

activation_trace.role: Causative diversion supplies the closure answered at the pericope's end.
The singular traversable course supplies the initially blocked orientation.
Inner sight supplies a capacity that the closing sequence supplements with exertion.
Spending capacity under strain supplies the enacted condition for newly disclosed passage.
Gentle guidance supplies the answering directional agency.
Plural traversable ways supply an unfolding field of access rather than one static object.
Beneficent good action supplies the lived quality accompanying successful guidance.

structural_cues: The focus has causative blocking plus a singular way; the closing ayah has exertion, causative guidance, and plural ways.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the singular/plural reversal and opposed directional agencies; I infer that striving participates in opening paths, while the live alternative takes the plural only as rhetorical breadth rather than progressively disclosed routes.

changed_reading.before: The decisive issue is possessing enough sight to locate an already complete road.
changed_reading.after: Sight must become striving; under that enacted commitment, guidance opens multiple traversable expressions of the way that blockage had closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus occurrence is securely a tribal proper name, not a return verb. It remains anchored through the identical supplied root and the context's explicit beginning-return pair; downstream prose should present it only as formal resonance and never translate the name as return.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first proper name at focus index 1 shares its supplied root with actual return language in 29:19.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch fixes the focus denotation and prevents lexical overreading.
Actual return after departure activates recurrence as a formal echo around the name.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the cycle that makes the echo consequential.

changed_reading.before: The name contributes only historical identification.
changed_reading.after: Without changing its denotation, the name may resonate with the context's beginning-return cycle, making its visible aftermath an emblem of recurrent warning and reckoning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This depends on the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the focus root to enumeration. It is valid as a list-level activation because the coordinated names are later rounded up as each case being taken for its offense; it must not be offered as the etymology or translation of the proper name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening proper name is coordinated with another accusative name and carries an alternate supplied mapping to the counting root.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch secures the historical referent.
The alternate enumeration branch activates the name's function as one counted item in a catalogue.
Totality gathers the preceding named examples into an exhaustive set.
Taking to account gives the catalogue an individualized judicial function.
Each culpable offense supplies the basis on which the counted cases differ.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely adds two names to a historical sequence.
changed_reading.after: The pair can be heard as counted cases in a judicial inventory, later closed by the declaration that every case is taken according to its own offense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ordinary syntax strongly selects road or means for the focus's way, so the eye-film branch is too distant for translation. It remains a live secondary echo because the word stands beside explicit sight and the nearby parable supplies an actual web; downstream prose should label it imagistic wordplay only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's way root at index 14 stands beside the sight root at index 16 after beautification and blocking.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary road branch preserves the syntactically primary reading.
A web-like eye film supplies a secondary optical image for how a way can be lost amid sight.
Ocular seeing keeps the optical domain active beside the path word.
A beautified surface supplies the attractive appearance through which the optical obstruction operates.
The nearby web-weaving creature supplies the concrete web image that activates the distant eye-film branch.

changed_reading.before: They see but are kept off an external road.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, the very path can resemble a web-like film laid across sight: perception remains active, yet attractive patterning occludes navigable direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading treats deeds as architecture rather than identifying the historical dwellings with the spider's house. It remains anchored by the focus's dwellings, beautifying, and works, plus the nearby explicit house-parable; prose should present it as an analogy of functional weakness, not a literal identification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins dwellings, displayed attractiveness, and human works, allowing practice to be inspected as constructed shelter.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling supplies the protective architectural domain.
Displayed beauty supplies the distinction between impressive appearance and load-bearing function.
Intentional work supplies the human construction process.
The parable explicitly authorizes transfer from a material structure to a human reliance-pattern.
Taking something for oneself parallels adopting protectors with constructing a house.
Shelter and dwelling supply the structure expected to protect its maker.
Loss of strength exposes the adopted structure's inability to perform its protective function.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings only preserve evidence after the failure of their inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: The adorned works can also be read as self-built shelter: intricate and socially usable in appearance, yet structurally unable to bear the protective load assigned to it.

strongest_changes: Perceptiveness became assayed, episodic practical capacity rather than a simple opposite of ignorance.
Dwelling-sites became intentionally legible, motion-arrested evidence encountered along an epistemic itinerary.
Satanic blockage became socially and humanly mediated through attractive practices, false liability promises, public obstruction, and self-authored deeds.
Prayer's counter-restraint and the closing movement from a blocked singular way to guided plural ways supplied active reversals of the focus.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses visible habitation, attractive works, causal diversion, a traversable way, and surviving sight. That combination supported forensic, affective, social, ritual, spatial, and optical mechanisms without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The final perceptiveness can remain genuinely possessed, episodically possessed, ironically self-ascribed, or some combination of these.
The grammar names Satan as agent but leaves open how much blocking is mediated by the deeds themselves and by human social networks.
The Aad-return, Aad-counting, and path-eye-film activations are formal or imagistic resonances, not secure lexical readings.

variants.scope_en: pairing beginning with return or repetition in action, creation, or speech

citation.role: Actual return after beginning supplies the second endpoint of the inference.

variants.image_en: returning after departure and doing again

variants.scope_en: This covers returning, coming back, doing again after beginning, repetition, asking for a second performance, mutual return, recurrence of fever or questioning, the command form عواد, and returned food.

citation.role: Travel through the earth makes knowing an embodied movement rather than static possession.

variants.scope_en: Going, travel, progression, and causing someone or something to move, whether voluntary or compelled.

citation.role: Directed examination supplies the deliberate reading of what travel exposes.

variants.scope_en: It includes looking at a thing with the eye, examining or reflecting with insight, and witnessing or taking heed where the source states that use.

citation.role: Presented beauty supplies the affective appeal attached to collective practice.

variants.scope_en: making, showing, or presenting something as beautiful, whether by action, speech, vegetation, lights, or stars

citation.role: Intentional deeds provide the repeated practice through which attachment is maintained.

citation.role: The worshipped object supplies a shared material center for the relation.

variants.scope_en: idols, cult-images, and stones treated as objects of worship

citation.role: Punitive distancing converts former closeness into mutual expulsion.

variants.scope_en: cessation of movement, settling, stillness, silence, and calming after agitation

citation.role: Manifest clarity supplies the conversion of arrested habitat into evidence.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه بان وأبان وتبين واستبان إذا ظهر الشيء واتضح، والبينة والدلالة الواضحة، والآيات البينات.
variants.scope_en: Includes becoming visible or clear, making something apparent, clear proof or sign, and clear verses or indications.

citation.role: Leaving an effect to remain supplies deliberate persistence of the material trace.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الإبقاء والتخليف، ومنه أن يترك على الشخص ذكر حسن أو تترك الأشياء خلف أصحابها
variants.scope_en: Includes leaving something to remain, preserving a trace, or causing things to be left behind after their owners depart.

citation.role: A visible sign supplies the evidentiary function assigned to what remains.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الآية بمعنى العلامة، وآية الرجل بمعنى شخصه، وخروج القوم بآيتهم أي بجماعتهم، وآية القرآن لأنها جماعة حروف، وإياة الشمس بمعنى ضوئها كالعلامة لها.
variants.scope_en: This branch covers a sign or mark, including a person's visible person, a whole group, a Qur'anic verse as a gathered set of letters, and sunlight as the sun's visible sign.

citation.role: Explicit clarity confirms that the retained trace is meant to disclose.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه بان وأبان وتبين واستبان إذا ظهر الشيء واتضح، والبينة والدلالة الواضحة، والآيات البينات.
variants.scope_en: Includes becoming visible or clear, making something apparent, clear proof or sign, and clear verses or indications.

citation.role: Understanding as restraint supplies the response expected from observers of the sign.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

variants.scope_ar: العلم والتمييز والفهم والتثبت والانزجار عن القبيح وما يفهم في القلب والتكلف أو الإظهار للعقل
variants.scope_en: knowledge, discernment, understanding, steadiness, restraint from disgraceful action, what is understood in the heart, and displays or affectation of reason

citation.role: Violent shaking supplies the event that interrupts ordinary settled motion.

branches.source_ayah_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه رجفان الشيء واضطرابه الشديد كالقلب والبحر والأسنان والشجر والرعد ونحو ذلك
variants.scope_en: It includes violent shaking or trembling of a thing, such as the heart, sea, teeth, trees, thunder, and similar cases

citation.role: Clinging low and remaining fixed supplies the terminal stillness left in the dwelling.

branches.source_ayah_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ

variants.image_en: clinging low and staying in place
variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه جثم الطائر أو السبع أو الإنسان إذا لصق بالأرض أو برك ولزم موضعه، والجاثم في موضعه، والمجثم موضع الجثوم أو الوكر، وما يثقل في موضعه كالعسل على المعدة أو العذوق إذا عظمت فلزمت مكانها.
variants.scope_en: Includes a bird, beast, or person crouching, kneeling, or clinging low to the ground and staying put; also the place of such crouching, a nest or perch, and source subcases of something settling heavily in its place.

structural_cues: A clear sign is said to have been left, another people pass from shaking to fixed crouching in their home, and the focus then points to dwellings as clarification.

resolved_evidence.focus_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

citation.role: Rebellious agency supplies the external pressure without exhausting the causal account.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الشيطان إذا أريد به كل عات متمرد أو عارم من الجن والإنس والدواب ومن صار كالشيطان وفعل فعله والخلق الذميم
variants.scope_en: This branch covers devilish or rebellious beings, humans, animals, devil-like behavior, and blameworthy traits called shaytan.

citation.role: Attractive presentation supplies influence rather than coercive compulsion.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه زين الشيء وزانه، وإظهار حسنه بالفعل أو القول، وتحسين الأرض بالنبات والسماء بالمصابيح أو الكواكب
variants.scope_en: making, showing, or presenting something as beautiful, whether by action, speech, vegetation, lights, or stars

citation.role: Intentional deeds preserve the people's authored contribution to the outcome.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه عمل المرء عملا؛ واعتمل إذا عمل لنفسه؛ والعمل الصالح والسيئ؛ وكل فعل يكون من الحيوان بقصد
variants.scope_en: It includes doing work, working for oneself, good and bad deeds, and any intentional act by a living being

citation.role: Manifest proofs remove lack of evidence as the sufficient explanation.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه بان وأبان وتبين واستبان إذا ظهر الشيء واتضح، والبينة والدلالة الواضحة، والآيات البينات.
variants.scope_en: Includes becoming visible or clear, making something apparent, clear proof or sign, and clear verses or indications.

citation.role: Self-exaltation supplies a voluntary posture of refusal toward the proofs.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ

variants.scope_ar: العظمة والكبرياء والتعالي، ومنه تكبر الإنسان واستكباره عن الحق، ومنه العظمة المستحقة لله
variants.scope_en: grandeur, majesty, pride, self-exaltation, and refusal to submit to truth; also rightful divine majesty

citation.role: Failure to escape pursuit supplies the collapse of imagined exemption.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَٰبِقِينَ

variants.scope_ar: الفوت وعدم الإدراك والغلبة بحيث لا يلحق الطالب المطلوب أو لا يعجزه المطلوب
variants.scope_en: Outstripping another so as not to be overtaken; not being missed, escaped, or frustrated by the one pursued

citation.role: Taking to account supplies the juridical consequence attached to authored conduct.

branches.source_ayah_ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًۭا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

variants.image_en: taking someone to account for a fault
variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه آخذته بذنبه ومؤاخذة الإنسان بما صدر منه.
variants.scope_en: Includes taking someone to task or holding someone accountable for a fault.

citation.role: Culpable offense supplies the individualized ground of accountability.

branches.source_ayah_ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًۭا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

variants.scope_ar: الإثم والمعصية والجرم والفعل المستوخم العاقبة
variants.scope_en: Wrongdoing, sin, culpable offense, and an act followed by bad consequence.

citation.role: The very self locates the injury and agency internally rather than solely in the tempter.

branches.source_ayah_ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًۭا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى عين الشيء، ذاته، حقيقته، جملته، كنهه وجوهره، واستعمالها للتوكيد.
variants.scope_en: It includes the very thing, its self, essence, whole identity, core, and emphatic self-reference.

structural_cues: Immediately after the focus, proofs lead to arrogance and failed escape; the catalogue then assigns each case its own offense and contrasts divine injustice with self-wrong.

resolved_evidence.focus_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

citation.role: Turning aside supplies the first directional restraint.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الصَّدّ والصُّدود بمعنى الإعراض والانصراف عن الشيء، وصَدّ غيره بمعنى منعه وصرفه عنه
variants.scope_en: This branch covers intransitive turning away or refusal, and transitive blocking, diverting, or preventing someone from something.

citation.role: Repeated intentional conduct supplies the habit-bearing substrate of that restraint.

branches.source_ayah_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه عمل المرء عملا؛ واعتمل إذا عمل لنفسه؛ والعمل الصالح والسيئ؛ وكل فعل يكون من الحيوان بقصد
variants.scope_en: It includes doing work, working for oneself, good and bad deeds, and any intentional act by a living being

citation.role: Prescribed embodied worship supplies the counter-practice that can redirect conduct.

branches.source_ayah_ar: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الصلاة الشرعية ذات الركوع والسجود والقيام بحدودها وإقامتها
variants.scope_en: Includes the legally prescribed act of worship with bowing, prostration, required limits, and proper performance

citation.role: Restraint from an act supplies the inverse directional force to the focus's diversion.

branches.source_ayah_ar: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

variants.scope_ar: النهي عن الشيء والزجر عنه وكف الفاعل أو انكفافه وتناهي الناس عن المنكر
variants.scope_en: forbidding or restraining someone from something, including ceasing and mutual forbidding

citation.role: Gross ugliness supplies one conduct-field from which the counter-practice turns its participant.

branches.source_ayah_ar: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الفحش والفحشاء والفاحشة بوصفها قبحا عظيما أو أمرا لا يوافق الحق، إذا لم يخصصه السياق بقول أو زنا أو بخل أو مجرد تجاوز قدر.
variants.scope_en: This includes fahsh, fahsha, and fahisha as gross ugliness or a matter not aligned with right, where the context does not specify speech, fornication, miserliness, or mere excess beyond measure.

citation.role: Condemned action supplies the second field blocked by ritual formation.

branches.source_ayah_ar: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

variants.image_en: the condemned thing that is corrected or rebuked
variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه المنكر من الأفعال والقبح الذي ترده العقول أو الشريعة والإنكار بمعنى تغييره أو ردع فاعله
variants.scope_en: It includes a condemned act, ugliness rejected by sound judgement or law, and انكار as changing it or deterring its doer

citation.role: Bringing a reality to mind supplies counter-salience against deceptive beautification.

branches.source_ayah_ar: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ

variants.image_ar: استحضار الشيء بعد النسيان أو مع الحفظ
variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الحفظ والاستحضار بالقلب والتذكر والاستذكار وما يكون خلاف النسيان.
